seoTitle: How to Change Country or Region on eBay Shipping
metaDescription: Update your country, ship-from location, and return address on eBay to keep shipping rates and listings accurate after relocating.
intro: If you've moved to a different country or you're managing more than one selling location, eBay doesn't have one single "country" switch — your registration address, shipping address, ship-from address, and return address are all separate settings that each need updating. Miss one and you'll end up with mismatched shipping rates or returns going to the wrong place, even after you think you've relocated your account. This guide follows the Addresses page exactly as it's laid out, so you can update each one in the right order.

steps.heading: Open My eBay from the account menu
steps.body: From the eBay homepage, click your account greeting near the top left to open the My eBay dropdown. It's a long menu — Summary, Recently Viewed, Bids/Offers, Watchlist, Purchase History, Selling, and more — but the address settings you need aren't in this dropdown itself. From here, head into your account settings rather than any of the shopping-focused links, since addresses live under the Account tab, not under Selling or Summary.

image.caption: The My eBay dropdown from the homepage. Address settings aren't listed here directly — they sit under the separate Account tab.

steps.heading: Go to Account → Addresses
steps.body: Once you're in account settings, the top of the page has three tabs: Activity, Messages, and Account. Under Account, the left-hand list includes Personal information, Sign-in and security, and Addresses — click Addresses. This single page is where every location-related setting lives: Registration address (your main contact address), Shipping address (where purchases you make get delivered), Ship from address (where your own sold items are shipped from), Return address (where buyers send returns), and Payment and pickup address. Each has its own Edit or Add button on the right.

image.caption: The Addresses page under Account. Registration, Shipping, Ship from, Return, and Payment/pickup addresses are each listed separately with their own Edit or Add button.

steps.heading: Update your Ship from address first
steps.body: If you sell on eBay, the Ship from address is the one that actually drives what buyers see: it's what eBay uses to calculate shipping costs and delivery estimates on your listings, so an outdated one here means every active listing is quoting the wrong rates. Click Edit next to Ship from address and enter your new country and full address. This is the setting most directly tied to "changing your country" for selling purposes, since it's what eBay treats as your operating location for shipping calculations.

image.caption: Ship from address highlighted on the Addresses page — this is the setting eBay actually uses to calculate shipping rates and delivery estimates on your listings.

steps.heading: Set or update your Return address
steps.body: Unlike the other entries on this page, Return address often shows an Add button rather than Edit, meaning many sellers never set one and buyers end up sending returns to the ship-from address by default. If you've relocated and want returns going somewhere specific — a different address than where you currently ship from — add or edit it here explicitly. Leaving this blank after a move is one of the more common causes of returns landing at an old address.

image.caption: Return address on the same Addresses page, shown with an Add button — worth setting explicitly if it should differ from your ship-from location.

steps.heading: Check registration and shipping addresses too
steps.body: Ship from and Return cover selling, but Registration address and Shipping address matter as well: Registration is your main contact address tied to the account itself, and Shipping address is where your own purchases as a buyer get delivered. If you've genuinely moved countries rather than just adjusted where you ship items from, update these too — leaving your registration address in the old country while everything else points to the new one can trigger mismatched region settings elsewhere on the platform, including currency and available payment methods.

steps.heading: Verify your live listings reflect the change
steps.body: After updating Ship from address, open a couple of your active listings and check the shipping section — the location and estimated delivery times should reflect the new address, not the old one. Existing listings don't always refresh instantly in every view, so it's worth double-checking at least one before assuming buyers are seeing accurate information. If anything still looks off after a few minutes, re-saving the Ship from address usually forces the update through.

faq.question: Why does my ship-from address matter on eBay?
faq.answer: It's what eBay uses to calculate the shipping rates and delivery estimates shown to buyers on your listings, so an outdated one leads to inaccurate pricing and delivery windows.

faq.question: Is there one setting to change my country on eBay?
faq.answer: No — country and location live across several separate settings on the Addresses page: Registration address, Shipping address, Ship from address, and Return address. Updating one doesn't automatically update the others.

faq.question: What happens if my return address is outdated?
faq.answer: Buyers may send returns to the wrong location, which can lead to delayed refunds or disputes. If no return address is set, returns typically default to your ship-from address instead.

faq.question: Where exactly do I find these address settings?
faq.answer: From My eBay, go into Account settings and select Addresses from the left-hand menu — all five address types are listed on that single page with Edit or Add buttons.

faq.question: Who needs to update these settings most?
faq.answer: Sellers relocating to another country or managing multiple shipping locations benefit most, since accurate ship-from and return addresses directly affect buyer trust and shipping cost accuracy.
